Bulk LTP Update via CSV
Step 1 - Download Template

Download the pre-filled CSV with all holdings. Open in Excel / Google Sheets, fill the CurrentLTP column with latest prices, then re-upload.

Step 2 - Upload Updated CSV
📂
Drag & drop CSV here
or click to browse · .csv files only
📊 Update LTP via Google Sheets (Live)
🔗 Connect Google SheetsPublish as CSV → paste URL

Maintain a Google Sheet with LTP data. Every time you click Fetch, it pulls the latest prices and updates all your holdings automatically.

Setup Steps:
1. New Google Sheet → Add columns: AssetClass | Ticker_or_CoinID | CurrentLTP
2. Fill your holdings (India EQ / US EQ / Crypto rows)
3. File → Share → Publish to web → Sheet1 → CSV format
4. Copy the published URL and paste above → Click Fetch
5. Save URL once - reuse every session for instant updates
Sample Sheet Format
${['India EQ|NSE:TITAN|3990','India EQ|NSE:INFY|1280','US EQ|NASDAQ:NVDA|168.50','US EQ|NASDAQ:AAPL|250.00','Crypto|bitcoin|6500000','Crypto|ethereum|195000'].map(r=>{const[a,t,l]=r.split('|');return``;}).join('')}
AssetClass Ticker_or_CoinID CurrentLTP
${a}${t}${l}
💡 Ticker must exactly match holdings (NSE:TITAN, bitcoin, NASDAQ:NVDA)
💡 US stocks: LTP in USD · India EQ & Crypto: LTP in INR
💡 Sheet updates automatically when you edit and re-fetch

Google Drive Sync
Keep your portfolio data backed up & synced across devices
1
Get Google API Key

Go to Google Cloud Console → Create Project → Enable Drive API → Create OAuth 2.0 credentials

2
Enter Client ID

Paste your OAuth 2.0 Client ID below. For GitHub Pages, add your domain to Authorized Origins.

3
Authorize & Connect

Click Connect, sign in to Google, grant Drive permission. Data auto-syncs to your Drive folder.

4
Auto-Sync Enabled

All changes save to InvestManagerPro.json in your Google Drive automatically.

Generate at console.cloud.google.com → APIs & Services → Credentials → OAuth 2.0 Client IDs
Not connected
Connect to enable cloud backup & sync
GitHub Pages Setup: Host this HTML file on GitHub Pages. In Google Cloud Console, under your OAuth 2.0 credentials, add https://YOUR-USERNAME.github.io to Authorized JavaScript Origins. No backend needed - this app is fully client-side.
